engine_version_note: UTMT infers the 2023.8 feature level; the exact original compiler version is not established.
placeholder_policy: Preserve every protected occurrence and its order. # may insert a number or an equipment target phrase. Displayed [Attack*0.5] formulas and explanatory X are not runtime placeholders.

typography.punctuation: Use straight ASCII quotation marks and apostrophes, hyphens and three periods. Use ASCII percent signs. Preserve protected line breaks.
typography.reason: All seven embedded fonts cover ordinary ASCII letters and punctuation. U+2014 and U+2019 are absent. No font modification is prepared.
typography.width_policy: Measure with actual font advances after translation; do not impose arbitrary character limits. Current scr_newline and merchant typewriter split at character boundaries and require English layout QA.

workflow.names_pass: Skipped: hand-authored glossary owns all classified name records.
workflow.deduplication: None at this preparation stage. Retain all instruction-site IDs and context. Repeated names share glossary spelling, not identity or description.
workflow.batching: Keep each scene with its paired phase/alias context, all four merchant source records together, and each UI assembly together. Do not mix field instructions in a request.
workflow.technical_sites: Exclude help lookup needles from free translation. Apply technical_overrides.json with matching visible terminology only during a later reviewed patch.
workflow.held_units: Do not queue dormant help, the undisplayed merchant fourth record, or the isolated Holy Mark formula discrepancy until their recorded review item is resolved.
workflow.patching: Translation and reviewed flags remain unset. No archive output or deployment in this phase.
